preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 5
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 5) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with a line containing two integers N and c (1 ≤ N ≤ 5e5, 0 < c ≤ 1e9), followed by N lines of two integers each (|x_i|, |y_i| ≤ 1e9).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 500000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is the number of points (1 ≤ N ≤ 5e5).

preconditions.expression: all(0 < int(line.split()[1]) <= 1000000000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: For each test case, c is a positive integer (0 < c ≤ 1e9).

preconditions.expression: all(abs(int(x)) <= 1000000000 and abs(int(y)) <= 1000000000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each point (x_i, y_i) has coordinates with absolute values ≤ 1e9.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit() and line.split()[1].isdigit() for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a single line containing two integers: the minimum number of checkpoints and the minimum number of operations.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= N for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The minimum number of checkpoints is at least 1 and at most N (the number of points).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 2 * N for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The minimum number of operations is non-negative and at most 2*N (each point can be moved at most twice to reach a checkpoint).

postconditions.expression: all((lambda test_case: (lambda points, c: (lambda checkpoints, moves: all(any((x - x_i) % c == 0 and (y - y_i) % c == 0 and abs((x - x_i) / c) <= 2 and abs((y - y_i) / c) <= 2 for (x, y) in checkpoints) for (x_i, y_i) in points) and sum(min(abs((x - x_i) / c) + abs((y - y_i) / c) for (x, y) in checkpoints) for (x_i, y_i) in points) == moves)(*parse_test_case(test_case)))(stdin.splitlines()[i*2+2:i*2+2+N]) for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output (checkpoints, moves) satisfies that every point can be moved to one of the checkpoints using at most two operations (each operation changes x and y by ±c), and the total number of operations is minimized for the given number of checkpoints. The checkpoints are chosen to minimize their count first, then the total operations.
